statements.nature_of_change: Optional step 3 of the dispatch was done. It is a pure strengthening: one instance binder [IsFiniteMeasure μ] was removed from each of the five theorems, and nothing else changed. Each proof now opens with `haveI := isFiniteMeasure_of_isLocallyLebesgue hμ` (RellichManifold.lean:105; it needs only [CompactSpace M] and hμ, which all five carry). The [∀ j, IsFiniteMeasure (σ j)] binders stay, because the dispatch did not cover them and they are not derived anywhere. How checked: (a) In the type dumps, each before-type minus the one `[@MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure.{u_1} M inst μ]` binder equals the after-type, instance names normalised. The binder no longer appears in any after-type. No other constant of the three modules changed type, and the only constant that disappeared is the prime. (b) An out-of-tree probe derives the old statements of rellichProp, constLimit, Reads.lem_positivity and Mfd.lem_positivity, with [IsFiniteMeasure μ], from the new ones by direct application, and compiles. (c) No caller elsewhere: the five are used only inside Rellich.lean, and grep finds no use in External.lean, the strict library or other packages; curation.toml lists them by name only.
